notes.title: Set dressing, new menus, and boss fight
notes.notes:
It's been a while since our last update, but we finally have things to show you. Firstly the world select scene has received proper set dressing and, in out opinion, looks much better. The world select will also change over time as you finish worlds. Secondly we've changed our menus to be more interactive. You can now walk around in the main menu, pause menu, and settings menu. Thirdly we've added a new world and a boss fight (good luck with these). Lastly here is the full list of what's changed:
[list]
[*] Added a new World, Goob's House
  [list][*] This one takes elements from all previous worlds and is meant to be played after you've finished The Town, Pirate Beach, and Wild West[/list]
[*] Reworked the world select scene
  [list][*] As mentioned above we've improved the set dressing and the scene changes as you finish levels. You can also find benches to sit on around the scene[/list]
[*] Added signs to every level that you can now kick down
  [list][*] If you kick all of them in a world you'll unlock an achievement
    [list][*] It seems that Steam doesn't allow achievements for playtest builds, so you'll have to use your imagination here[/list][/list]
[*] Added a boss fight
  [list][*] For the boss fight you'll fight the pirate ship from the Pirate Beach in a single level that changes as you save more ingredients[/list]
[*] Updated the death screen
  [list][*] The death screen will now make you move Goob's ghost up to quit the game or down to retry from your last checkpoint[/list]
[*] Made enemies attack as soon as the level fully starts
  [list][*] The internal countdown that most enemies have will now start at 0 when you start moving in a level instead of whatever the attack interval is set to[/list]
[/list]

We've additionally fixed an issue that made it so that people who have gained access to the playtest from Steam (and not a key) will actually be able to download the game. Sorry about that.

Thank you for your support and for taking the time to help us improve this silly little game we're trying to make.

notes.title: Localization & game save now available
notes.notes:
It's been a while, but we're back with a new update. This one isn't as big as the power up rework, but it's a much needed one nonetheless.
We've added a Norwegian localization that can be accessed under the "language" tab in the options menu. We've also added an outline around certain things to make them more visible for color blind players based on feedback from a playtester.
The final thing that's been added for this update is the game save. The game will now save your settings between play sessions as well as the level you last played. This will make it easier to come back into the game without having to go back to the level you last played or by having to set your settings back to what you prefer.
The last thing on the list for this announcement is that after some consideration we've decided to scrap the Unsettling Forest world to focus on polishing the existing worlds and to create the final world set for release.

Thank you as always for taking the time to test Up to no GOOB and for all of your support, it means a lot to us!

notes.title: Camera fix and minor tweaks
notes.notes:
The power up rework unfortunately introduced an issue which caused the cameras in the world select scene and the Unsettling Forest to no longer follow the player. This issue has now been fixed. In addition to this we've also made several minor tweaks to the game. The tweaks are as follows:
[list]
[*] Added new input options. You can now use the arrow keys and right stick to move
[*] Added new death screens. We've added more death screens to show off what killed you
[*] Increased the radius that a pirate ball can land around the player. Both the minimum and maximum distance have been increased
[*] Implemented a cap on the amount of pirates that can spawn
[*] Fixed the horse running backwards in level 5 of the Wild West
[*] Made the cactus shake before expanding in Wild West
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the player to climb trees
[*] Allowed projectile and cowboy attacks to collide with more obstacles
[/list]

We'd love to know what you think about the better telegraphing of the cactus and the added cover that has been added. There aren't enough or substantial enough changes this time to warrant a new form, so please leave your thoughts in the comments of this post. While we're on the topic of forms, if you haven't filled out the [url=https://forms.gle/aQGDFJK2g8CbV2wm7]initial feedback form[/url] or the [url=https://forms.gle/A9TpN8rAEQTySFdV9]power up rework form[/url] we'd appreciate it if you did.

Once again, thank you so much for the support and for taking your time to playtest our game!

notes.title: Power up system rework
notes.notes:
We've recently reworked how the power up system functions internally. Most power ups are unaffected by this. The troll power up has received some needed upgrades. You'll now see an animation and hear a sound cue whenever you move to power up the troll transformation. We've also made it so that the power up powers down if you don't move for a few seconds.

With this build we have some known issues:
[list]
[*] The power up and down effect shows in the middle of the screen
[*] The troll power up will play super short audio clips when just barely moving enough to trigger the animation
[/list]

If you haven't already, we ask that you fill in the [url=https://forms.gle/j1HHviWXonsME2rm7]initial feedback form[/url] and here is the [url=https://forms.gle/Tgk4juUH8GT5Bbsi7]power up feedback form[/url].

Thank you once more for taking the time to test Up to no GOOB and for all of your support!

notes.title: Welcome to the Up to no GOOB Playest
notes.notes:
Welcome to the official playest for Up to no GOOB!
As a playtester you aren't signing an NDA and are free and even encouraged to have other people play the game on your machine.
We do, however, ask that you do not share images of footage from our most in-progress stuff. Currently this refers to the Unsettling Forest world.
When you're done testing the build we also ask you fill out this little survey so that we can get an overview about what works and what doesn't work. A new survey will be sent out for every update and may be directed towards specific changes we are looking for feedback at. [url=https://forms.gle/eYgofX6KGAsiw7X96]Here is the link to the first survey.[/url]

For your convenience the test builds have some debug buttons you can press to quickly get to areas you are trying to test. Press "K" to go to the world select screen and 1-6 to go to the specified level in a world. Note that the game creates a log file each time you start the game. This is to help us debug any issues you might encounter. The log files can be found at the following paths: Windows: [i]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Team SnuggleMoth\Up to no GOOB\Log[/i] Linux: [i]$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Log[/i] or [i]$HOME/.config/unity3d/Log[/i].

Thank you so much for all the support you guys are giving us, it truly means so much to us!
